Wesley Wood graduated from the University of Alberta Materials Engineering program in the spring of 2020. He has been a member of the Canadian Centre for Welding and Joining since January 2020 where he volunteered to be a part of a project to use Arduino Prototyping and Mach3 USB to control a welding torch using closed loop control.

Currently, Wesley is looking to further his education at the University of Alberta in a Graduate Studies program and work in industry.

#### Project

Control of a welding torch using Arduino Uno and Mach3 USB
